summary: This resolution sets procedures for House floor consideration of S.J. Res. 18 and S.J. Res. 28 (disapproving two CFPB rules), H.R. 1526 (limiting district court injunctions), and H.R. 22 (requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register for federal elections), waiving points of order, limiting debate to one hour each, and blocking related discharge motions.
